The search turned up the official Tauri 2 announcements, which trace the release from alpha and beta through release candidate to stable.

- **Beta:** The team released v2.0.0-beta.0 with mobile support for Android and iOS, a new access control system for commands, and multiwebview support. Support for notifications, dialogs, NFC, barcode reading, biometric authentication, clipboard and deep link was included among the mobile APIs.
- **Release candidate:** The team said it considered Tauri 2 stabilized and no longer expected breaking changes. Users on the latest beta could migrate automatically, but only on the latest RC version of the Tauri CLI.
- **Stable (2.0):** The stable release was announced as the new major version. Official plugins now follow the major version number, and the official plugins will follow the major version of Tauri to make compatibility with Tauri's major version visible at a glance.

The official release notes page for the stable version wasn't among the results, so these come from the blog posts. The results also included a Chinese-language releases page that said "Release notes not supported" for v2 at the time it was crawled.
